'''Ussin Fajinak''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Lieutenant Commander/Legends|Lieutenant Commander]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]], who was first officer of the ''[[Aurodia]]'' during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He died during the conflict and his name was included on a war memorial, which his wife visited.
